common: Close WaveForms before running a script; only one application can own the AD3.
Power off before changing wiring. AD3 GND, scope 1−, scope 2− and bench supply negative all connect to board GND. Never connect a ground clip to the negative rail.
Use the AD3 flywire scope inputs directly (1×, DC). Use short ground returns. DIO0…15 remain INPUTS and can observe 0–5 V logic; never connect DIO to the negative rail.

Bench supply provides +5.00 V. Start with a 0.10 A current limit for standalone power/digital tests; 0.20 A for power + digital + one channel. These are conservative starting limits, not expected measured currents. If the supply remains in CC or a component heats, switch off and investigate; do not automatically raise the limit.

For digital and channel fixtures, provide +3.30 V at digital J2.3 from either a separate regulated bench channel OR AD3 V+ with --ad3-3v3. Never connect the two sources together. AD3 V− and W2 are unused. Never connect the Raspberry Pi during these tests.
Scripts pause for connection changes and rail readings. They do not control or turn off the bench supply. Ctrl+C shuts down AD3 outputs; you must turn off the bench supply immediately afterwards.
order: Power standalone → digital standalone → left with tested power/digital → right with tested power/digital → recheck rails with the full stack.

steps.title: Check AD3 pump stimulus before attaching it
steps.instructions: Keep W1 disconnected from the board. Connect scope 1+ to W1 and 1− to AD3 GND. The script generates 192 kHz, 0–5 V square wave on W1 and verifies it. W1 is then disabled before you attach the board.

steps.title: Power board supply and negative rail
steps.instructions: Power board only; no other boards. Connect bench +5 V to J3.2, bench return to J3.1, and W1 to J3.10. No digital board may drive PUMP at the same time. Turn on the bench supply only at the prompt; the script then starts W1. Let the pump settle.
steps.expect: +5 V: 4.75…5.25 V; negative rail: −5.25…−3.50 V. Gross ripple screen ≤150 mVpp over an 8 ms record, not a microvolt-noise measurement.

steps.title: Check both voltage references
steps.instructions: Keep the same supply and pump drive. Switch off the bench supply and let W1 stop at the prompt before moving the two scope leads.
steps.expect: VREF_P: 2.35…2.65 V; VREF_N: −2.65…−2.35 V; each within 3% of half the measured +5 V rail; ripple ≤150 mVpp.

steps.title: Digital board rails
steps.instructions: Digital board only; no power or channel boards. J1 shunt 1–2 selects the oscillator. Bench +5 V → J2.1 and GND → J2.2. Supply +3.3 V → J2.3 using the selected source. With power OFF, tie QL (J4.12) and QR (J4.14) to GND so mux inputs do not float.

steps.title: Clock tree and Pi clock levels
steps.instructions: Keep J1 at 1–2. Wire the DIO inputs once as below, then attach the scope inputs to the Pi clock outputs. Use grabbers or temporary test wires with power off; DIP pins are close together.
steps.expect: CLK6M 6.144 MHz; MCLK 1.536 MHz; BCLK/PI_BCLK 3.072 MHz; LRCLK/PI_LRCLK 48 kHz; PUMP 192 kHz. ±2%, 35–65% duty. Pi clock highs 2.7…3.6 V, lows −0.3…0.45 V. Non-inverting Pi clock paths: median rising-edge delay −1 sample…120 ns (provisional, sample-limited check).

steps.title: Four mux cases and DIN level shifting
steps.instructions: Retain DIO wiring; move scope 1+ to DIN and 2+ to PI_DIN. The script prompts for all four QL/QR combinations: 0/0, 1/0, 0/1, 1/1. For 0 tie that bus input to GND; for 1 tie it to the board +5 V. Turn power OFF for every change. No channel boards may be attached. Do not use AD3 3.3 V digital outputs to drive 5 V HC inputs.
steps.expect: MCLK LOW selects QR, HIGH selects QL. At settled samples, DIN and PI_DIN must agree with the selected input (>99.5%). Scope verifies both the 5 V DIN and 3.3 V PI_DIN levels for every case.

steps.title: Check supplies under the channel load
steps.instructions: Connect ONLY the already-tested power and digital boards plus this one channel through correctly aligned bus connections. Bench +5 V goes to digital J2.1; +3.3 V to digital J2.3. Remove ALL temporary QL/QR-to-rail test jumpers left from the digital tests. Ground the unused channel bus input on DIGITAL ONLY if needed. The populated channel output must never be tied to a rail. W1 is disconnected for now.
steps.expect: Same +5 V and negative-rail screening windows, now with a real channel load.

steps.title: Reference voltages at the channel
steps.instructions: Power off before moving scope leads; keep the fixture otherwise unchanged.
steps.expect: Both references within their windows and within 3% of half +5 V.

steps.title: No-input modulator and feedback check
steps.instructions: With power off, short J20.1 to J20.2 (GND). Wire all DIO inputs below. RV20 must be fitted/wired; record its setting. Set J21 1–2 for left or 2–3 for right. DIO5 connects to J7.12 for left, or J7.14 for right to verify the selected bus output.
steps.expect: MCLK 1.536 MHz ±2%; Q must toggle with density 35–65%. QN and DACN complement Q; DACP and selected bus output follow Q (>99.5% settled agreement). This is a smoke test, not a noise-floor measurement.

steps.title: Two-level 1 kHz audio-response test
steps.instructions: Power off, remove the J20 input short, then connect W1 to J20.1 and AD3 GND to J20.2. Scope 1+ monitors J20.1; scope 2+ monitors J7.2. Keep DIO wiring. The script applies a zero-offset 1 kHz sine at 0.10 Vpeak, then 0.25 Vpeak; keep RV20 unchanged. It captures Q with MCLK, samples Q on falling clock edges, and averages groups of 256 bits.
steps.expect: Measured input amplitude within 20% of setting, with clean 1 kHz fit. Recovered density must contain 1 kHz (fit R² ≥0.25, density amplitude ≥0.003); larger input must produce 1.5…3.5× the smaller output amplitude. Absolute gain, THD, SNR and 24-bit performance are not certified.
